LanguageData.PhobosBurns_SettingBurnLoadDesc: Adds up every burn on the skin into one condition: cold sensitivity, hunger, pain and strain on the heart that grow with the area burned.
LanguageData.PhobosBurns_SettingBurnShockDesc: Large burns can kill within days unless the burns are tended, the patient rests in bed and the shock itself is tended. Older patients and inhalation injuries do worse.
LanguageData.PhobosBurns_SettingAirwayDesc: A pawn that burns, or is burned about the head and neck, may get an airway burn whose swelling builds over hours. A tracheotomy relieves it.
LanguageData.PhobosBurns_SettingSmokeDesc: Breathing smoke damages the lungs for days and can lead to pneumonia. The smoke itself comes from Combat Extended when that mod's smoke runs, otherwise from the game's own smoke, which fires now make under a roof.
LanguageData.PhobosBurns_SettingCarbonMonoxideDesc: Fires in closed rooms make carbon monoxide, which a gas mask does not stop. It builds in the blood, confuses, drops and kills, and clears slowly in clean air.
LanguageData.PhobosBurns_SettingAcuteSmokeWithCombatE: Also apply this mod's smoke inhalation with Combat Extended

Off by default: with Combat Extended's smoke running, its own smoke inhalation condition is the one that applies, and this mod adds only the lasting lung damage and carbon monoxide. On, both acute conditions apply.
LanguageData.PhobosBurns_SettingRemoveAll: Remove every burn condition from every pawn
LanguageData.PhobosBurns_SettingRemoveAllDesc: Before switching this mod off: press the button, save, then remove the mod. Burns themselves stay; only this mod's own conditions go.
LanguageData.PhobosBurns_MessageRemovedAll: Removed {0} burn conditions. Save now, then the mod can be switched off.
LanguageData.PhobosBurns_TipBurnLoadPlain: Burned skin loses fluid and heat. Tend every burn, keep the patient warm and fed, and in bed if it is serious.
LanguageData.PhobosBurns_TipBurnLoad: About {0}% of the body is burned. Tend every burn; past 15% burn shock follows.
LanguageData.PhobosBurns_TipBurnShockPlain: Tend the burns, keep the patient in bed, and tend the shock itself to give fluids.
LanguageData.PhobosBurns_TipBurnShock: Revised Baux score {0}; heading for {1}% with the care given now.
LanguageData.PhobosBurns_TipBurnShockEngineer: Age {0} + burned {1}% + inhalation {2}; burns tended {3}%; in bed: {4}. Target = (score - 36) / 74, times 1 - 0.6 x tended - 0.3 if in bed (floor 0.1).
LanguageData.PhobosBurns_TipCarbonMonoxidePlain: Get the patient into clean air, outdoors if possible. A gas mask does not help.
LanguageData.PhobosBurns_TipCarbonMonoxide: Blood carrying carbon monoxide: {0}%. Halves every 5.3 hours under a roof, 3 hours in open air. Source: {1}.
LanguageData.PhobosBurns_TipLungInjuryPlain: Tending helps the lungs recover. Badly damaged lungs invite pneumonia.
LanguageData.PhobosBurns_TipLungInjury: Lung damage {0}%. Recovers 4% a day untended, 16% a day tended well.
LanguageData.PhobosBurns_TipAirway: {0} hours since the burn; this episode peaks at {1}% of the full swelling, at {2} hours, and is gone by {3} hours.
